post.description:
Check claims of a transcript against the collection's uploads, then the web.

Sends transcript sentences to the configured OpenAI-compatible model and,
for claims not settled by the uploads, search queries to the web provider.
Poll status_url for the result; events use `t_ms` of the recording.

get.description: Whether the fact-check is configured and which third parties receive text.

post.description:
Generate follow-up questions from transcript, fact-check findings and uploads.

Sends transcript sentences, findings and upload passages to the configured
OpenAI-compatible model (same as the fact-check). Questions with a spoken
passage carry `t_ms` of the recording and appear as `question` events.

Compare a typed answer with the question's evidence and upload passages.

Result is a verdict with a verbatim quote and an optional follow-up
question; no points or grades.

Store in S3 and enqueue extraction, chunking and embedding.

Poll status_url until status is `ready` or `failed`. Scanned PDFs without
a text layer are not supported (no OCR).
Top-k passages of ready sources, hybrid vector + keyword ranking.

schema.title: Response Search Sources Sources Search Post
